rare.name: Rare
rare.summary: Worked on Sea of Thieves (UE4) & Everwild (UE5)

highlights.engine-work: Regularly optimising core and gameplay systems to improve performance on Sea of Thieves, working to a live service schedule cadence. As well as creating foundational systems for future gameplay features.
highlights.engine-upgrade-work: I worked on integrating and updating middleware software into the engine as well as upgrading Unreal Engine to new versions.
highlights.tech-rep-work: Technical representative for gameplay teams to aid in performance and memory approval for game features.
highlights.ui-tech-rep-work: Technical Representative for the UI team to help guide best practices for UI systems and aid in performance and memory approval for features as well as creating features/tooling to improve feature signoff processes and workflow issues.
highlights.support-work: Created tooling to help wider teams adhere to memory budgets, improve UI workflow and capability alongside game side system functionality, and generate clarity on game performance through telemetry systems.
highlights.compliance-work: Enforced ruling on coding standards and conformance for future engine version upgrades as well as compliance regulations to aid in new platform releases.
highlights.charity-work: Captain of Rare Women's football team and also help coordinate events with the charity SpecialEffect.

bcu-supervisor-2.name: Birmingham City University
bcu-supervisor-2.summary: Birmingham City University, 2D Game Programming Module for VFX Students

highlights.uni-work: Aided the teaching of VFX students to help make a 2D game in python. This included a lot of problem solving and debugging with students.

highlights.engine-work: Main encompassing work was optimising buoyancy calculations server side under network relevancy conditions. I also contributed to fixing input issues on Sea of Thieves.
highlights.gameplay-work: 6 month secondment to the Gameplay team to release Season 8. My main focus was tracking ship damage and faction setup.

bcu-supervisor.name: Birmingham City University
bcu-supervisor.summary: Birmingham City University, 2D & 3D Game Programming Modules for Comp Game Tech Students

highlights.uni-work: Aided the teaching of 2D and 3D Unity based modules for first year students. This included discussion about game ideas and how it can tie in the assignment brief, problem solving issues students were seeing as well as general coding practice advice.

highlights.work: I worked as a Customer Service Assistant, helping customers with their inquiries and ensuring a positive shopping experience.
